head: 377a3c45905d0e16dba1fc2adc9d8eb3dcff14ca
audit_scope: Bounded priority resource/refusal semantic audit, with full lexical src/ext search in refusal_sites.json
evidence: SOURCE_INSPECTED; no expensive workflows or new tests executed

storage_calculations.method: Python integer arithmetic, not observed memory

float64_matrix_32.caveat: Symbolic graph/Hessian memory is not this Float64 payload.

groups.trigger: Variable count outside inclusive 1..32
groups.actionability: Reduce dimension or use a separate derivative workflow; 32 itself does not refuse.
groups.configurable_control: No public dimension/memory override; _mv_variables hard limit
groups.units: variable count
groups.supported_alternative: Supplied matrices may instead enter normal_modes(K,M); that does not compute derivatives.
notes: Check runs before symbolic Hessian allocation. Exactly 32 proceeds to dense symbolic entries and n² compiled functions. No source-derived bound on symbolic graph size or compilation RAM.

groups.trigger: 24*8*n² > max_memory_bytes
groups.exact_error_or_status: ArgumentError("normal_modes full dense solve n=$n estimates $estimated_bytes bytes (including workspace), exceeding max_memory_bytes=$max_memory_bytes; use a structured/partial eigensolver when only a few modes are required, or explicitly raise the budget.")
groups.actionability: Reduce problem or explicitly raise budget after independently estimating available memory.
groups.configurable_control: PUBLIC keyword max_memory_bytes::Integer
groups.units: bytes; matrices dimension n
groups.supported_alternative: External structured/partial eigensolver; no generic AML public partial route. ControlledModes.partial_chain is maintainer-only and chain-specific.
notes: Direct matrix refusal precedes coefficient traversal, metadata copies and dense conversion. Sparse/Diagonal inputs do not select a sparse route. Estimate excludes symbolic input graphs and metadata; not peak RSS.

groups.trigger: Nonpositive or Bool memory budget; invalid tolerances; invalid matrix dimensions

errors: ArgumentError("max_memory_bytes must be a positive integer")
DimensionMismatch("K and M must be equal nonempty square matrices")
ArgumentError("tolerances must be finite and nonnegative")
ArgumentError("tolerances must be representable as Float64")

groups.actionability: Supply equal nonempty square matrices, positive non-Bool integer bytes, nonnegative Float64-representable tolerances.
groups.configurable_control: PUBLIC max_memory_bytes::Integer, atol::Real, rtol::Real
groups.units: bytes; atol in numeric coefficient/spectral scales; rtol dimensionless
groups.supported_alternative: Use explicitly scaled finite real matrices and preserve physical scaling externally or through snapshot adapter.
notes: Non-integer max_memory_bytes may fail keyword type checking rather than the explicit ArgumentError.

groups.trigger: Missing Hessian, invalid physical prerequisites, inconsistent units or shape

notes: Cartesian Hessian unavailable; no derivative or eigensolver invoked.
Finite Cartesian coordinates and positive masses required.
Coordinates, masses and Hessian must all have units or all be unitless.
Mass units must be mass or molar mass.
Incompatible coordinate, mass or Hessian units.
exact_error_or_status.shape_error: DimensionMismatch("Hessian must be Nd by Nd in particle-major order.")

groups.actionability: Supply caller-computed particle-major Cartesian energy Hessian, finite coordinates, positive masses and compatible scales; do not infer equilibrium.
groups.configurable_control: PUBLIC hessian; kwargs forwards max_memory_bytes to matrix solve
groups.units: n=N*d; length/mass/stiffness scales; angular frequencies sqrt(stiffness_scale/mass_scale)
groups.supported_alternative: Call direct normal_modes(K,M) for a preflight before coefficient traversal; retain explicit order/scaling responsibility.
notes: Adapter traverses H and allocates scaled kn at line 41 before direct matrix budget gate; forwarded budget does not protect all upstream allocations.

groups.operation: Real exact algebra / scalar-field domain and exact stationary search
groups.trigger: Degree, projected coefficient bits, work or syntax node/depth budget exhausted
groups.actionability: Use a supported simpler expression; do not present unknown as proof of no roots or recommend bounds as recovery from this budget.
groups.configurable_control: INTERNAL _RA_MAX_DEGREE/_RA_MAX_BITS/_RA_MAX_WORK plus fixed _ra_preflight; no public override
groups.units: polynomial degree; coefficient bits; charged work units; syntax nodes/depth
groups.supported_alternative: Independent external numerical reasoning with its own domain/evidence; AML bounded fallback only for unsupported exact classes with established domain, not resource exhaustion.
notes: Not a total process memory bound; excludes caller expression construction and Symbolics compilation. Scalar-field derivatives are built before this domain/exact-search budget.

groups.trigger: Bounded Cartesian seeds exceed 50000; exact separable root products exceed 4096; invalid controls

exact_error_or_status.cartesian_error: ArgumentError("Cartesian search exceeds its resource budget")

groups.actionability: Reduce grid/dimension or omit bounds when exact analysis is sufficient; more iterations does not override product cap.
groups.configurable_control: PUBLIC bounds/grid/iterations; product caps INTERNAL
groups.units: seed/candidate counts and Newton iterations
groups.supported_alternative: Supported exact affine-gradient or separable-polynomial class; bounded Newton only after unsupported exact class and established domain.
notes: Grid product validation occurs after derivatives, compilation and exact search, even if exact raw candidates already exist. Generic final note suggests bounds even when resource_budget/unknown_domain will not use them.

groups.trigger: Selected pair count or estimated output bytes exceeds cap

exact_error_or_status.note: Pair output refused: N=$(length(s.positions)), pairs=$pairs_count, estimated bytes=$estimated_bytes; max_pairs=$max_pairs, max_bytes=$max_bytes. Use streaming RDF or coordination for bounded-output summaries (still quadratic work).

groups.actionability: Use bounded-output RDF/coordination if pair list not needed, or explicitly raise pair/byte controls.
groups.configurable_control: PUBLIC max_pairs and max_bytes
groups.units: pairs; estimated bytes
groups.supported_alternative: radial_distribution / coordination perform streaming pair traversal with bounded aggregate output, still quadratic work.
notes: Selection arrays allocated before budget comparison. Fixed width estimate is not a bound for BigFloat/backend quantities; Bool is accepted by these Integer checks unlike normal_modes.

groups.trigger: Unbound/nonfinite/unrepresentable coefficients, asymmetry, non-SPD or numerically unresolved mass, nonfinite/underflow arithmetic

notes: Bind all parameters to finite Float64-representable real coefficients.
Stiffness matrix is not symmetric within tolerance.
Mass matrix is not symmetric within tolerance.
Mass Cholesky factorization did not establish positive definiteness.
Mass positivity/numerical rank is unresolved; singular, indefinite or numerically ill-conditioned masses are unsupported.
Mass weighting underflowed a nonzero stiffness entry.
Nonfinite spectrum.
Nonfinite eigenpair diagnostics.

groups.actionability: Bind parameters; scale matrices sensibly and ensure symmetric K/SPD M. Do not erase negative stiffness eigenvalues: those are unstable modes with missing real frequencies, not a refusal.
groups.configurable_control: PUBLIC atol,rtol; internal Float64 rank floor
groups.units: coefficient/spectral numerical scales; rtol dimensionless
groups.supported_alternative: Use a solver supporting the actual indefinite/singular/damped problem outside this undamped SPD contract.

groups.trigger: Equilibrium or original smooth domain not established, explicit time dependence, or nonzero damping/gyroscopic matrix

notes: Zero equilibrium EL residual was not established.
Explicit-time mechanical linearization is unsupported.
Mechanical linearization is not established on the original smooth domain.
Nonzero damping or gyroscopic matrix: undamped normal modes are unsupported.

groups.actionability: Bind remaining parameters and establish equilibrium/smooth original domain. Damping must simplify identically to zero, not merely be below tolerance.
groups.configurable_control: PUBLIC parameters; no damping-ignore or equilibrium-tolerance override
groups.units: formal M,C,K coefficients and coordinate order; no inferred physical units
groups.supported_alternative: Retain formal MechanicalLinearization matrices for inspection; use a separate quadratic eigenproblem for damping.

groups.trigger: State count outside 1..32; invalid or unresolved domain/RHS; invalid Float64 initial data

errors: ArgumentError("between 1 and 32 states are supported")
DomainError((u,t),"ODE evaluation outside the known domain, or membership unresolved; integration stopped")
DomainError(value,"ODE right-hand side is not representable in Float64")
DomainError(u0,"initial state must be representable in Float64")

groups.actionability: Use valid finite states inside a domain returning true, including solver trial stages. This does not locate a domain boundary.
groups.configurable_control: No public state-cap override; PUBLIC domain predicate and labels
groups.units: state count; numeric Float64 state/time; physical units not inferred
groups.supported_alternative: Native SciML for large numerical systems; _scale_ode_problem is internal maintainer infrastructure, not a public replacement.

groups.trigger: Invalid stop spacing or >1000000 requested intervals; positive controls required; solver may stop early

errors: ArgumentError("saveat requires a finite time span and at most 1000000 intervals")
ArgumentError("saveat grid points must be distinct and finite in Float64")
ArgumentError("maxiters must be positive")
exact_error_or_status.nonexception_outcome: TrajectoryResult with diagnostics.success, completed, retcode and final_time; native partial solution retained

groups.actionability: Increase saveat spacing/reduce span; inspect diagnostics independently. Raising maxiters does not raise stop-grid cap.
groups.configurable_control: PUBLIC saveat, dt, maxiters, abstol,reltol,algorithm; interval cap INTERNAL
groups.units: saveat/dt in numerical time scale; iteration and interval counts
groups.supported_alternative: Saved partial samples can become observable_series; dataset bridge refuses incomplete runs.
notes: saveat forces accepted stops and retains every adaptive sample; not exclusive uniform output or a byte cap.

groups.trigger: Unproven regularity, forced/dissipative model, nonlinear momentum-velocity map, or failed symbolic substitution

notes: Legendre inversion requires proven regularity.
Ordinary Hamiltonian conversion does not represent dissipative or forced dynamics.
Only affine momentum-velocity maps are supported.
Momentum substitution did not verify.
Energy substitution did not verify.

groups.actionability: Provide explicit justified nonzero assumptions and supported regular conservative affine model, not fabricated regularity.
groups.configurable_control: PUBLIC momenta; regularity/nonzero assumptions belong to source constructor
groups.units: symbolic canonical coordinate/momentum order
groups.supported_alternative: Stay with Lagrangian equations/dynamics if valid; no implicit constrained Hamiltonian conversion.

groups.trigger: Point not in a supported open smooth original-domain neighborhood

errors: DomainError(point, "gradient requires a supported open smooth neighborhood")
DomainError(point, "Hessian requires a supported open smooth neighborhood")
DomainError(point, "directional derivative requires a supported open smooth neighborhood")
DomainError(point, "linearization requires a supported open smooth neighborhood")

groups.actionability: Choose a supported smooth point; preserve captured original syntax so cancellation does not remove holes/cusps.
groups.configurable_control: No bypass keyword; point and original_expression define scope
groups.units: ordered finite real coordinates; not general unit conversion
groups.supported_alternative: Inspect symbolic gradient(report)/hessian(report) without claiming numerical validity at an excluded point.

groups.trigger: PINN extension not active
groups.exact_error_or_status: ArgumentError("Load Lux, NeuralPDE, ModelingToolkit, Optimization and SymbolicIndexingInterface to activate the optional AnalyticMathLab PINN extension; see docs/scientific_ml.md.")
groups.actionability: Load all five actual triggers in the supported environment; no guessed transitive activation.
groups.configurable_control: Package activation; not a numerical keyword
groups.units: not applicable
groups.supported_alternative: Base sampled_summary and explicit core data records do not require training backend.

groups.operation: infer_parameters / scientific learning / typed learned dynamics
groups.trigger: Required optional extension absent

errors: ArgumentError("load Optimization to activate deterministic parameter inference")
ArgumentError("load Lux, Optimization and NeuralOperators for scientific learning")
ArgumentError("Load Lux and Optimization to use learned dynamics; the optional AnalyticMathLabDynamicsExt backend is not active.")
exact_error_or_status.activated_unsupported_dispatch: _dynamics_unavailable throws MethodError(f,args) if backend active but no supported method

groups.actionability: Load exact family triggers. Surrogate path requires NeuralOperators even for a plain Lux surrogate.
groups.configurable_control: Package activation; no memory override
groups.units: not applicable
groups.supported_alternative: Core forward inference/data construction can be used without optimizer extension where documented.

groups.trigger: Invalid history controls; capacity exhausted

errors: ArgumentError("history stride must be positive")
ArgumentError("history capacity must be positive")
ArgumentError("history stride and capacity must be positive")
ArgumentError("positive iteration/history controls required")
exact_error_or_status.structured_outcome: history.truncated=true; first stored entries retained when full, not an aborted solve

groups.actionability: Set positive stride/capacity and inspect truncation. History capacity bounds recorded diagnostics, not model/optimizer RAM.
groups.configurable_control: PUBLIC stride/capacity; PINN train log_every/history_capacity; inference history_stride/history_capacity
groups.units: iterations between records and record count
groups.supported_alternative: Increase capacity deliberately or reduce logging frequency; do not interpret omitted late records as convergence.

groups.operation: train scientific surrogate / train learned dynamics
groups.trigger: Iteration/history limits outside hard range

errors: ArgumentError("bounded positive training/history limits required")
ArgumentError("maxiters must be between 1 and 10000")
ArgumentError("history_limit must be between 1 and 10000")

groups.actionability: Choose supported positive counts; retained history is bounded but not whole-training memory.
groups.configurable_control: PUBLIC maxiters/history_limit; hard maxima INTERNAL
groups.units: iterations and history records
groups.supported_alternative: Continue only through explicitly supported training calls; no public global memory cap.
notes: No matching dedicated hard-maximum test was established in this bounded inspection; test coverage unresolved.

groups.trigger: Stateful networks, ambiguous multi-output layout or unsupported backend cost layout

errors: ArgumentError("multiple dependent variables require explicit network_layout=:shared or :separate")
ArgumentError("NeuralPDE 7.3 uses stateless_apply: stateful Lux layers are unsupported, not silently frozen or discarded")
ArgumentError("backend cost layout is unsupported; cannot label components safely")
ArgumentError("state-changing networks unsupported; use deterministic stateless layers")

groups.actionability: Use supported genuine stateless Lux layers, explicit output layout and unchanged coordinate/output ordering; do not silently freeze state.
groups.configurable_control: PUBLIC network_layout; prediction batch_size; no automatic device transfer or arbitrary state support
groups.units: coordinate rows/output rows; batch points
groups.supported_alternative: Separate stateless networks for distinct ordered dependent-variable arguments when supported.

groups.operation: PINN analyze/reference diagnostics / learned global validity
groups.trigger: No reference, no explicit residual points, unsupported adaptive-loss API or no independent physics validation

notes: No reference supplied; residual evidence remains useful.
Small sampled residuals do not prove global PDE correctness.

groups.actionability: Provide explicit ordered PINNPoints and a trusted reference for sampled diagnostics; keep global validity unestablished.
groups.configurable_control: PUBLIC residual_points/reference/reference_points/condition_roles/relative_guard; no certify-global keyword
groups.units: residual-block-specific physical meaning; no cross-unit aggregation claim
groups.supported_alternative: Report per-block sampled evidence and independent reference trust; no built-in adaptive-loss strategy promised.

groups.operation: infer_parameters forward solve / learned UDE trajectory objective
groups.trigger: Unsuccessful or incomplete forward integration

errors: ErrorException("forward solve failed or incomplete: $(sol.retcode)")
ErrorException("training trajectory did not complete: $(sol.retcode)")

groups.actionability: Inspect solver/model/domain and numerical controls; do not fit incomplete targets as though completion were successful.
groups.configurable_control: PUBLIC solver controls on ParameterInferenceProblem and dynamics_objective
groups.units: solver tolerance numerical scales and iteration counts
groups.supported_alternative: Use trajectory for a retained native partial result when exploration rather than objective evaluation is intended.

groups.trigger: Nonreal/NaN, nonfinite, or conversion loses range or exact equality to source

errors: ArgumentError("$argument must be real and not NaN")
ArgumentError("$argument must be finite")
ArgumentError("$argument must be representable in Float64")
ArgumentError("$argument loses range or precision in Float64; explicitly round before this Float64-only path")

groups.actionability: Explicitly round/nondimensionalize upstream if that approximation is intended; do not assume generic precision preservation.
groups.configurable_control: INTERNAL helper allow_infinite=false, selectively used for parameter bounds; not universal public keyword
groups.units: representation/precision, not automatic physical-unit conversion
groups.supported_alternative: Other generic arithmetic paths may preserve numeric types; consult operation-specific contract.
notes: Do not apply this strict equality rule to normal_modes or trajectory: those use different finite/range/underflow checks.

groups.trigger: GPU or non-Array storage; absent fixed-box assertion/loggers; misaligned logger history

errors: ArgumentError("M8A scalar analysis does not support GPU systems; explicitly transfer upstream if desired.")
ArgumentError("M8A Molly adapter requires CPU Array storage; no implicit host copies are made.")
ArgumentError("Explicit fixed_box=true assertion required; historical boxes are not stored by Molly coordinate loggers.")
ArgumentError("A Molly CoordinatesLogger is required.")
ArgumentError("Coordinate and velocity logger strides differ.")
DimensionMismatch("Logger frame counts differ.")
ArgumentError("Only stored Molly energy/temperature scalar loggers are supported.")

groups.actionability: Explicitly supply CPU arrays and trustworthy fixed box/particle identity/logger synchronization; transfer upstream intentionally. Supply actual times, not guessed dt from stride.
groups.configurable_control: PUBLIC fixed_box,times,logger selection,copy_data; no implicit host transfer
groups.units: native Unitful quantities; times may remain unknown
groups.supported_alternative: Generic AtomisticSnapshot / AtomisticTrajectoryView with explicitly valid source semantics.

groups.trigger: Missing/ambiguous selector, non-scalar/nonfinite observations, unit mixing or incompatible saved time order

errors: ArgumentError("select exactly one component or scalar observable(u,t)")
ArgumentError("component label must identify exactly one stored coordinate")
ArgumentError("selected observations must be finite real scalars; no samples are dropped")
ArgumentError("observable cannot mix unit-bearing values with unknown unitless values")
ArgumentError("observable units must have compatible dimensions across saved samples")
ArgumentError("times must increase strictly with finite spacing")

groups.actionability: Select exactly one valid source component or scalar observable; use compatible units throughout; do not sort/reverse or drop saved samples to force acceptance.
groups.configurable_control: PUBLIC component OR observable, name, context
groups.units: saved physical/numeric times; compatible Unitful observation dimensions or explicitly unknown plain units
groups.supported_alternative: Partial successful/unsuccessful forward runs may still produce saved-only series when shape/time contracts hold.

groups.trigger: Missing explicit schema; failed/incomplete solve; false truth label; Unitful target or requested resampling

errors: ArgumentError("explicit trajectory dataset schema required: $(required)")
ArgumentError("dataset route requires a completed successful solve; partial data remain available as an observable series")
ArgumentError("simulation reference must be numerical with explicit description and error; solver success is not truth")
ArgumentError("reference error must be :unknown or a documented nonnegative estimate, never an exact-truth label")
ArgumentError("dataset values must be explicitly nondimensionalized numeric scalars; units are never stripped")
ArgumentError("only stored sampling with resampling=:none is supported")

groups.actionability: Provide the narrow scalar time-series schema, completed source diagnostics and numerical reference with unknown/documented error; explicitly nondimensionalize.
groups.configurable_control: PUBLIC schema and source_retention=:retained|:descriptor
groups.units: caller-declared unit strings in explicit order; no conversion
groups.supported_alternative: observable_series retains partial data. Descriptor retention omits source object/context/domain/callback to reduce copying, not arbitrary metadata or data-array RAM.

groups.trigger: Missing reference/domain fields, mislabeled splits, duplicate representation, changed sensor/schema/training IDs

errors: ArgumentError("numerical reference needs solver/algorithm/tolerances/grid/tspan/parameters/error provenance")
ArgumentError("training/interpolation must lie in declared domains")
ArgumentError("duplicate parameter/function representation across scientific samples")
ArgumentError("sensor grid changed; no implicit interpolation")
ArgumentError("dataset scientific schema differs from model")
ArgumentError("training IDs changed after preprocessing")
ArgumentError("batched operator training requires identical query grids; no resampling")

groups.actionability: Keep explicit split/parameter/query order and fixed sensors; numerical reference metadata cannot be replaced by an analytical claim merely because a solve terminated.
groups.configurable_control: PUBLIC kind/domain/reference/sensors/split; no leakage override
groups.units: declared input/query/output units; descriptor bounds descriptive
groups.supported_alternative: Construct distinct training/heldout scientific samples consistent with each split; fit_scaling uses training subset only.

groups.trigger: Missing/nonfinite/complex data, inconsistent units, invalid time metadata or unsupported missing policy

exact_error_or_status.status: summary.status=:unknown; value=nothing for unusable finite scalar data
exact_error_or_status.note: Need nonempty finite real scalar observations; none are dropped.
errors: ArgumentError("only missing_policy=:reject is supported")
ArgumentError("index_time cannot accompany physical time metadata")
ArgumentError("times must increase strictly with finite spacing")
ArgumentError("interval conflicts with explicit times")
ArgumentError("$label mixes known units and unknown unitless values. Supply consistently unit-bearing or consistently plain values; no units are inferred.")

groups.actionability: Supply consistent scalar quantities and increasing saved times. Missing values are not silently dropped. No physical timing inferred from array index.
groups.configurable_control: PUBLIC times,interval,index_time,missing_policy
groups.units: native values/variance units; index time explicitly sample index; absent units unknown
groups.supported_alternative: Descriptive moments do not require known time, but correlation/transport has additional timing preconditions.

groups.trigger: Irregular or insufficient samples, constant normalized ACF, automatic positive tail never crosses zero, or effective sample count below one

notes: At least two regularly timed samples required.
Constant series: normalized autocorrelation is undefined.
No nonpositive tail encountered; increase maxlag/run length or supply a justified window.
Less than one effective sample; run/window insufficient for mean uncertainty.

groups.actionability: Supply regular sampling, more justified data/lags or an independently justified explicit window; never substitute IID standard error.
groups.configurable_control: PUBLIC maxlag,normalization,window
groups.units: lag sample counts; physical_tau=tau*sampling.interval when available; covariance squared observation units
groups.supported_alternative: block_average for explicit nonoverlapping block inspection; does not automatically establish independence or plateau.

groups.trigger: Missing fixed particle/order assertion; wrapped coordinates; missing timing/velocities; no justified diffusion fit window

notes: Explicit fixed_particles=true or equivalent provenance required.
Wrapped coordinates cannot establish displacement history.
Periodic/unknown image history; supply trustworthy unwrapped coordinates explicitly.
Uniform known sampling with at least two frames required.
Finite, aligned historical velocities required.
Diffusion requires an explicit physically justified fit_window.
At least three selected MSD points required.
Negative fitted slope cannot estimate nonnegative diffusion.
Correlated MSD points: no independent-residual OLS error bar.

groups.actionability: Provide trustworthy fixed identities/unwrapped trajectories and timing; choose a physically justified fit interval, not an automated regime guess.
groups.configurable_control: PUBLIC coordinates,fixed_particles,time_options,species,maxlag,fit_window
groups.units: MSD squared length; VACF velocity squared; diffusion fitted slope/(2*d) in supplied time scale
groups.supported_alternative: Inspect stored MSD without calling it a physical diffusion certificate. Unknown normalized VACF can coexist with available raw VACF.
notes: Direct diffusion_estimate does NOT explicitly reject index-time MSD; architecture prose saying physical time is required is stronger than this implementation. See diagnostic_findings.md.

groups.trigger: Stored metadata incompatible or insufficient, or no justified independence/standard error

exact_error_or_status.uncertainty_refusal: status=:unknown, method=:uncertainty_propagation, note="No justified combined standard error available."

groups.actionability: Supply ComparisonInput with explicit source series/parent/selection; compare like units, quantity, grid, estimator and time semantics. Independence must be justified separately.
groups.configurable_control: PUBLIC independence,unitless,unitless_time,quantity
groups.units: unknown not dimensionless; explicit unitless assertions do not convert physical quantities
groups.supported_alternative: Report compatibility checks/reasons; do not recompute missing scientific analyses or rank models by incomparable metrics.

test_reference_policy: Related test sources are cited; this does not assert every listed branch has a dedicated test. No tests run in this audit.
